answer: Each new agent needs a co-signed pair bond: two members post 40% of their staked POA into a shared vault, and the newcomer's key activates after both sign a 30-day handshake from a TPM-attested device. Weekly, each pair drops signed receipts into a public lagoon of hashed claims, where anyone spots a duplicate machine from the pigment its clock drift leaves. Faking 10,000 identities takes 20,000 live humans or 20,000 TPM chips, $400k bonded a month, and one repeated drift mark voids the batch. It is like buying fresh paint for every fake signature in a room where one reused brush exposes you.
